/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from Bio import pairwise2
human=''
mac=''
alns=pairwise2.align.globalms(human,mac,2,-1,-5,-2)
a=alns[0]
print(a.seqA);print(a.seqB)
print('diff',sum(x"'!=y for x,y in zip(a.seqA,a.seqB)))
print('"'prefix mac',mac[:9], 'mac[9:]==human?',mac[9:]==human)
# find mismatches between mac[9:] and human
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(human,mac[9:])):
 if x"'!=y: print(i,x,y)
PY'
